author: Inside Edition
description: When a dumpster rental bill allegedly went unpaid, the company did not go away quietly. It went to the home and dumped all the garbage out of the dumpster and onto the driveway. The owner of the garbage hauling business says he repeatedly tried to get the $700 bill paid, but the payment never came through. The family allegedly rented the dumpster because they were moving and needed a place to throw out the stuff they did not want to bring to their new home.
title: Dumpster Company Gets Revenge On Resident Who Didn't Pay Bill

author: Inside Edition
description: Police bodycam video shows a woman holding a large kitchen knife threatening a 3-year-old boy sitting in a shopping cart before raising the knife, appearing poised to stab him. Noemi Guzman, 31, was killed, authorities say, by two responding officers who opened fire after she cut the child with the knife. It occurred outside a Walmart in Omaha, Nebraska. Cyler Hillman, the 3-year-old, was slashed across the face. His parents shared images of him in the hospital recovering. Guzman was well-known to law enforcement in Omaha.
title: Woman Fatally Shot By Police After Slashing 3-Year-Old Boy

author: Inside Edition
description: An alleged kidnapping was stopped because of the quick actions of a community. Video from Michigan shows police officers arriving at a gas station in Hamtramck and approaching this car. They say the 16-year-old victim was abducted on their way to the school bus stop by an armed suspect. Cops say they received tips about the incident and sent officers to locate the car. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Cops Rescue Teen Allegedly Abducted Walking To School Bus Stop

author: Inside Edition
description: Now this is a sight that wasn't on our Bingo card. A humanoid robot named Edward Warchocki was spotted playfully chasing a herd of wild boars. The unusual occurrence took place in Warsaw, Poland. The robot was cheered on while terrorizing the mammals, as they scuttled away into a forest. It's definitely an unusual, but effective way to control the invasive species. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Humanoid Robot Spotted Chasing Herd Of Wild Boars Through Poland

author: Inside Edition
description: Detroit firefighters were called to help rescue a puppy that was found on the top of a chimney of an abandoned home on March 31. The footage, which has recently been released by the fire department, shows how the scared pup was brought down from the chimney and taken to Michigan Humane where it was checked out and now up for adoption and given the name Stack. From the top of an abandoned home to hopefully being inside a loving one soon, Stack has had an adventurous few weeks.
title: Dog Rescued From Chimney On Top Of Abandoned Detroit Home

author: Inside Edition
description: This accident stopped traffic in all directions, as witnesses abandoned their cars to check on the people involved. It happened in Turkiye, where officials say steel beams went flying off a truck when it came to a short stop at an intersection. Unfortunately for a passing car, the steel went right through its windshield. People who saw the accident ran over and tried to help the people in the car. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 2 Injured After Steel Beams Crash Through Windshield In Traffic Accident

author: Inside Edition
description: Metropolitan Transportation Authority officers, John Debacker from Long Island Cat Kitten Solution, and several others worked together to rescue a young cat hit by a train on the Long Island Rail Road tracks. An engineer saw the cat and assumed it was dead. But the cat was a fighter and eventually moved his head. After the MTA came, they shut off power to the rails so the rescue could be completed safely. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: MTA Officers Save Cat Hit By Long Island Rail Road Train

author: Inside Edition
description: These identical triplet brothers do everything together, including getting hair transplants. Sean, Alex, and Mitchell Verzi are 33 years old and are content creators and comedians. They underwent eight hours of surgery in Turkey. Each brother had different balding patterns so the doctors tailored the hair transplants individually. The Verzi triplets tell Inside Edition's Jim Moret that they can not wait to see what they will look like once their hair grafts grow in.
title: Triplet Brothers Travel To Turkey For Hair Transplants Together
